blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency (PDEA) is investigating another Filipino, identified by the alias “Boyet,” who allegedly arranged a private jet to transport drugs from Laos to the Philippines. PDEA has also identified a Filipino passenger using the alias “Fahad,” who was arrested at an airport in Laos in connection with the alleged smuggling of 521 kilograms of suspected methamphetamine. “And we know, we have evidence that si Boyet is tagadito sa Luzon at yung si Fahad may address sa Luzon parehas po.
